prompt: We take money through two processors. Our ledger (`left.csv`) records every sale regardless of which processor handled it, while each processor gives us its own payout export — `stripe.csv` and `paypal.csv`. A ledger row is accounted for if it appears in either export. Columns are the same across all three files: date, amount, currency, reference, description; dates look like 2024-01-31. Write a `reconify.yaml` that reconciles the ledger against both processors in a single run.
